verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents IMAP/SMTP access to its inboxes, so standard clients like Thunderbird or Apple Mail can retrieve your mail over an open protocol (agentmail-docs-8). Custom domains let you keep your address if you move providers (agentmail-docs-11), and a published OpenAPI spec covers programmatic retrieval of messages and threads (agentmail-probe-2, agentmail-docs-47). However, nothing in the evidence describes an actual export or account-portability feature. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all data (messages, attachments, labels, threads, configuration) in open formats such as mbox/EML/JSON, a documented account-exit or deletion path, and independent confirmation that a full export works.
